response.overview: To add an additional room 1-866-829-1297  UK +44-204-586-5316) (a second stateroom) to an existing Oceania Allura Cruise  1-866-829-1297  UK +44-204-586-5316) , you cannot do it yourself online. You must call Oceania Allura Cruise  customer service directly at 1- 866-829-1297  UK +44-204-586-5316)  (US)  contact your travel agent to book the new cabin and link it to your original reservation 1-866-829-1297  UK +44-204-586-5316) .
